title: Scarlet Lady Dolphin Adventures

services.name: Dolphin Tour
services.desc: Our Most Popular Trip! Adult (Ages 12+): $38 Child (Ages 3-11): $33 Infant (Ages 2 & under) 1 Hour and 30 Minutes The Tour Come tour the waters of the Lydia Ann Channel in search of wild dolphins in their natural habitat! Enjoy cold beer, frozen margaritas, Daiquiris, sodas, and waters on the full bar on the Scarlet Lady. Due to TABC regulations no outside drinks or coolers will be allowed on the trip. Their will be a full narration about the history of Port Aransas, and interesting fun facts about dolphins and other marine life. There is shade and seating for everyone aboard 1.5 Hours · Tour the Waters of the Lydia Ann Channel!

services.name: Sunset Dolphin Tour
services.desc: A Perfect Way to End the Day! Adult (Ages 12+): $43 Child (Ages 3-11): $38 Infant (Ages 2 & under): $5 1 Hour and 30 Minutes The Tour View amazing sunsets on the water aboard the Scarlet Lady™! Watch in awe as wild dolphins frolic and play in the light of the setting sun out on the Lydia Ann Channel. A photographer’s dream the Sunset Tour will give you once in a lifetime opportunities to witness the beauty of Port Aransas backed by a setting sun. Don’t forget to get a snap shot of the iconic Lydia Ann Lighthouse at sunset, it will sure to make a photograph that you will be 1.5 Hours · A Perfect Way to End the Day!

services.name: Fall/Winter Industrial Cruise
services.desc: Specialty Cruise! Person: $58 (All Ages) 2 Hours The Tour This is one of the newest tours Port Aransas has to offer. This tour will cruise down the ship channel towards the Port of Ingleside. There is live narration describing the area along the way to the port. Once at the port the narrator talk about the rigs and platforms that are in port for repairs. We will be able to give as much information as the different companies supply us with. The tour is a total of 2 hours and then once you return to the docks lunch will be served. The tour includes lunch with water or tea. $58 per person · 2.0 Hours · Includes lunch!

includes: The tour includes lunch with water or tea.
Gratuities for the restaurant staff are not included.
gap: Cancellation policy is as follows: If you call 48 hours prior to your scheduled date you may cancel your reservation but there is a 25% cancellation fee. There is no refund available for any cancellations or no shows inside the 48 hours.
blurb: The Scarlet Lady™ is one of the most exciting Dolphin Adventure Tours and Specialty Cruises in Port Aransas. Cruise along the waters of the Lydia Ann Channel in search of wild dolphins, flocks of seabirds, and enjoy views of the iconic Lydia Ann Lighthouse. Tours depart from Captain Kelly’s Deep Sea Headquarters, conveniently located right next to the ferry landing in Port Aransas.
